info.name: Hospital Patient Pathway - Version 2 HPAS - Camunda 8.9
info.description: Version2 only: Process_HPAS, HPAS: message names, 37 forms. Import the companion Version 2 environment. Create an instance, publish Referral received, then complete human tasks in Tasklist. Event branches run inside an active instance. Select requests individually; do not run this toolkit as a whole collection. See README.zh-CN.md and README.md.

exec: if (pm.environment.get("processDefinitionId") !== "Process_HPAS") throw new Error("Select the Version 2 HPAS environment (Process_HPAS).");

item.name: 02 - Deploy version2 BPMN and all 37 forms

request.description: Set the file working directory to version2. Select ONLY hospital-patient-pathway.bpmn and forms/*.form. Do not deploy source/, evidence/, version1/ or the frozen acceptance snapshot. Reselect all 38 files in resources if imported paths do not resolve. Let Postman set the multipart boundary.
Check the deployed definition/version before creating an instance. The frozen acceptance snapshot uses the same process ID.

Starts at Top_Start and waits at Top_Catch_Referral. Send 05 - Referral received NEXT, before filling SP01_CheckDocuments in Tasklist. Uses the latest active Process_HPAS definition. Empty referralId and patientId values get unique version2 IDs. Clear both before a new independent run.

Send AFTER creating an instance. Releases Top_Catch_Referral and opens SP01_CheckDocuments in Tasklist. This is an intermediate catch, not a message start that creates an instance. All version2 messages correlate on referralId, including laboratory results. HTTP 200 confirms publication only. Inspect the current element in Operate. TTL is 15 minutes; every Send creates a new message ID. Do not run all alternatives sequentially.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get("referralId")) throw new Error("Set referralId for the current HPAS instance first.");
